Emergency Repair
Function: Reduces MG heating up speed and removes ammo. Fixes reload speed and continuously restores HP based on Max HP.
Effect 1: MG heating up speed ▼ 100% for 3 sec.
Effect 2: Removes 100% of ammo.
Effect 3: Constantly recovers 2.22% of the skill user's final Max HP every 1 sec over 3 sec.
Effect 4: Reload speed is fixed at a 60% increase for 1 rounds.
